bio.text: Scott Peters represents California's 50th Congressional District in San Diego County and was first elected to the U.S. House in 2012.

He worked as an environmental lawyer for 15 years, then served on the San Diego City Council, where he became the city's first City Council President, and later chaired the San Diego Unified Port District.
He earned his undergraduate degree at Duke University and attended New York University School of Law, and he lives in La Jolla.
